candidate_requirements.requirement: Reconcile all current and recent drug ingredients, including exact inpatient supply status of olmesartan during this admission.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The causal hypothesis hinges on knowing whether olmesartan exposure is currently continuing or has been interrupted; brand changes may conceal exposure.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Full medication list with inpatient administration record; explicit plan to document every active ingredient daily during withdrawal.
candidate_requirements.deadline: At the start of the proposed reassessment period, before interpreting any withdrawal response.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Plan objective reassessment of fluid/nutritional status and electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, phosphate, albumin) with defined monitoring frequency.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Severe depletion (K 2.8, Mg 0.7, PO4 1.9, albumin 2.3) makes electrolyte and nutritional safety monitoring mandatory during any withdrawal trial.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Daily bloods plus targeted volume assessment; acceptable alternatives include twice-daily potassium initially if correcting.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Within the first 24 hours of the proposed reassessment plan.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Propose objective outcome measures for the medication withdrawal trial (e.g., stool frequency/weight, diarrhoea scores) recorded before and during withdrawal.
candidate_requirements.rationale: No withdrawal response is yet known; without prespecified objective measures, the trial cannot be interpreted and causality may be overclaimed.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Stool charting, daily weight, symptom diary; any prespecified measurable endpoint.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Baseline measures recorded before or at initiation of withdrawal.
